source_text.body:
Run a paper-trading portfolio with a morning research routine
A tutorial for building a Claude Code agent that manages an Alpaca paper-trading portfolio with a scheduled morning research routine over a watchlist.
More AI trading agents
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The guide sets up a project with a CLAUDE.md rulebook, a watchlist.json, and Python helper scripts for Alpaca data and orders. Three scheduled Claude Code routines run on weekdays: morning research at 9:45, trading at 10:00, and an end-of-day journal. The agent checks market status, pulls bars and news, places limit orders, and writes a markdown journal.
How it went
It is a tutorial and reports no results from running it. It says paper results will look better than live ones because of slippage and partial fills, and that the agent executes a strategy rather than predicting markets.
Worth knowing
The author says Claude inference for three daily sessions typically costs a few dollars a month, rising with bigger watchlists. Cap tool calls and trim data to control it.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Build me an agent that manages a paper-trading portfolio on Alpaca using my paper API keys stored in [env file or location]. Each morning at [time] it should research my watchlist of [tickers], write a short note on each, and propose trades with reasoning, then log everything to [file or folder]. Use paper trading only, never live. Pause and show me the proposed orders before placing any, and stop once a morning run completes end to end.
Original source: https://www.mindstudio.ai/blog/build-ai-trading-agent-claude-code-alpaca
